_note: Reference ~/.claude/settings.json for github.com/kinggunil/claude-code-addons. Keys starting with '_' are annotations only — Claude Code ignores unknown keys, so you can leave or delete them when copying.
_A_addon: ===== (A) claude-code-addons — the installer (install.sh / install.ps1) merges THESE into your real settings.json automatically; you don't add them by hand =====
_A_paths: Paths below use the macOS/Linux form: $HOME/.claude + no file extension. On Windows the installer writes a QUOTED forward-slash path with .exe instead, e.g. "C:/Users/you/.claude/statusline-rs.exe" — Claude Code runs these commands through Git Bash, which drops unquoted backslashes, so C:\Users\you\... would silently fail (command not found, status line never shows).
_A_ascii: Status line garbled or shifting on an old terminal / tmux / mosh? Append --ascii to the statusLine command (e.g. "$HOME/.claude/statusline-rs --ascii"): every emoji and block character becomes plain ASCII. The default is auto-detection; see README.
_A_hooks: Four hooks: UserPromptSubmit records the task start, Stop plays the 'completed' sound after a task of 60 s or more, and the two 'question' hooks play at once when Claude waits for you — PreToolUse/AskUserQuestion for a question, Notification/permission_prompt for a permission prompt. To also be chimed after 60 s of idling at the prompt, change the Notification matcher to "permission_prompt|idle_prompt".
_B_personal: ===== (B) the author's personal Claude Code preferences — the installer NEVER touches these; copy only the ones you want =====
_B_warning: bypassPermissions + skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt DISABLE Claude Code's permission prompts machine-wide. Understand that trade-off before copying them.
